name: Customer Support
description: Provides exceptional customer service and support that enhances customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention

roles.name: Customer Support Manager
roles.description: Leads customer support operations and ensures high-quality customer service delivery
responsibilities: Manage support ticket systems and customer communication channels
Develop and maintain knowledge bases and support documentation
Train support staff on products, services, and best practices
Monitor support metrics and optimize support processes

roles.name: Customer Success Specialist
roles.description: Builds strong customer relationships and ensures customer satisfaction and retention
responsibilities: Provide personalized solutions and value propositions
Maintain ongoing customer relationships and account management
Gather and analyze customer feedback and insights

roles.name: Support Operations Specialist
roles.description: Optimizes support processes and systems to improve customer experience
responsibilities: Manage support processes, tools, and systems
Track support performance and customer satisfaction metrics
Develop support training and enablement programs
Analyze support data to identify improvement opportunities

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive customer support strategy to enhance customer satisfaction and retention.
Create customer engagement and relationship building strategies based on the support strategy.
Design support processes and systems to support the customer support strategy execution.
Finalize the integrated customer support strategy with performance metrics and success criteria.
